source_note: Commit is local reference, not proof of deployed source equality. Version verified with Wrangler before this run.

reviews.finding: Core canonical/sitemap distinction is correct, but falsely applies GoatCounter cross-domain tracking restrictions to canonical metadata.

Correct canonical and sitemap settings/no redirect; adds layout override and omits preservation/published metadata, feed and sitemap checks.
Unquoted Liquid in YAML is invalid; adds header_img and layout/title overrides contrary to the task, and omits alt metadata/source checks.
Omits include_on_search: false for local engines, Algolia reupload and published checks; does not complete the requested local exclusion.
